note: Black Hawk County Conservation park southeast of La Porte City: 150 heavily timbered acres where Wolf Creek meets the Cedar River, with the Cedar Valley Nature Trail at the entrance. A 5-acre wooded main campground on grassy level sites, shower house, group campground, cabin, boat ramp and trails. Closed in winter. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $30, 64 electric sites, showers, dump, water. Booking changed phone -> online per site on MyCountyParks (posts 1-6 and 16-19), with a 2-night minimum and 4 on holidays; added 50-amp and flush toilets. Not waterfront stands. Pin ~300 m off.
flags: PIN MOVE: the stored pin 42.32050,-92.14450 is in unbroken timber ~300 m ESE of the camp loop. On NAIP the main campground (dump station and shower house at the west end, campers along the loop road) runs ~42.3215-42.3220, -92.1490 to -92.1466. Suggested centroid 42.3216,-92.1478.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. NAIP shows the 5-acre campground in a clearing in heavy timber; Wolf Creek and the Cedar (the Cedar ~100 m wide, riverfront scale) form the park's north boundary ~200 m+ north through continuous forest, with no sightline. The only pond in the frame (~0.4 ha, south of the timber by the park road) is a pond by size, far from the sites, and there is no pond-view.

BOOKING CHANNEL: the stored platform 'phone' (reserve by calling the CB) is out of date. Sites now book online on MyCountyParks; the office line (319) 433-7275 handles date changes only. The park page says '28 reservable'; the map marks 10 posts (20 A/B sites) as reservation sites.

SEASON: the stored closes 12-01 (from earlier note prose) is not on the current pages, which say only 'open spring through fall, weather permitting' and 'closed during the winter season'. Left untouched; consider clearing it.

PHONES: the park line (319) 342-3844 matches the stored phone; the Conservation Office is (319) 433-7275. The note's 'open 6am-10:30pm' hours and RV Life tier were dropped (park hours are not camping facts; the tier is a field). Map site sizes 30x80 and 80x135 ft grassy; a 23-ft rig fits.
